**Build the mobile app that construction professionals rely on every day.

**Every day, tens of thousands of construction professionals around the world use the Dalux app to inspect buildings, document progress, navigate BIM models, capture photos, report issues and collaborate directly from active construction sites.

We're looking for Mobile Software Engineers who want to build software that solves real-world problems at scale.

**What You'll Be Building

**You'll join one of our cross-functional product teams responsible for developing and improving the Dalux mobile application.

Together with developers, product managers and designers, you'll help shape new features from the product discussion through implementation, testing and release.

Our app is built using C# and .NET MAUI , allowing us to share the majority of our codebase while integrating with native iOS and Android capabilities whenever it makes sense.

**Some of the challenges you'll work on

**Mobile development at Dalux goes far beyond forms and lists. You'll help solve challenges such as:

• Building reliable workflows for construction sites with limited connectivity

• Integrating with mobile hardware such as 360 cameras and GPS antennas

• Optimizing performance across both Android and iOS devices

• Designing intuitive user experiences for professionals working in demanding environments

• Continuously improving the speed, quality and usability of one of the industry's leading mobile applications

**Our engineering culture

**You'll become part of a product team where engineers have real ownership.

We believe the people building the software should influence how it's built. That means short decision paths, close collaboration with product and design, and plenty of room to propose new ideas.

Our development teams work using agile principles with a strong focus on quality, collaboration and continuous improvement.

**We'd love to hear from you if you

**

• Have a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or a similar technical field

• Enjoy solving complex engineering problems

• Care about building products that people genuinely enjoy using

• Like collaborating with other developers, designers and product managers

Experience with one or more of the following is a plus:

• C#

• .NET MAUI

• Kotlin

• Swift

• Flutter

• React Native

If you don't have professional mobile experience yet but are passionate about mobile development and have a strong software engineering foundation, we'd still encourage you to apply.

**Why Dalux?

**At Dalux, you'll build software that makes one of the world's largest industries more digital, efficient and sustainable.

Our products are used in more than 140 countries, and mobile is central to that experience.

All software development happens from our headquarters in Copenhagen, where you'll work alongside a growing community of software engineers in an environment that values knowledge sharing, technical discussions and continuous learning. We also have monthly social events and various clubs for those who want to take part.

You'll find a flat organization with a high degree of trust, opportunities to influence the product, and colleagues who care deeply about building great software.

**Ready to join us?

**If you'd like to help build the mobile platform used by tens of thousands of construction professionals every day, we'd love to hear from you.

We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

**About Dalux

**Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005. We develop digital tools that help make the construction industry smarter and more efficient through intuitive software and Building Information Modelling (BIM). Today, our solutions are used on construction projects in more than 140 countries worldwide.

**Join our Pizza & Beer event

**Sign-up for our free Pizza & Beer event the 29th of October 2026 at Dalux from 16:00: Pizza and Beer with Dalux

During the event, you can hear more about Dalux and the career options through presentations and mingling - all while getting delicious Pizza and beer/drinks!

**About GoWish, Ønskeskyen ☁️

**At GoWish, we’re building the world’s leading wish-list and social shopping platform - a place where you can make a real impact and have fun doing it.

We’re on a mission to reinvent gifting for millions. We win together, driven by curiosity, ownership, and bold ideas that turn into real products. We experiment cross-functionally, push for excellence, and keep things playful as we grow - together.

**Team & Role Overview

**We're actually opening two positions on the team, at two different levels of seniority.

• One for an engineer with 2-4 years of experience and meaningful, production-scale work behind them.

• One for a more experienced engineer, with 4-6 years across one or two companies and a strong track record at production scale.

Not sure which one is you? Apply anyway — tell us where you're at, and we'll place you at the right level together.

The Product API team is the team behind the systems that turn billions of products into the fast, reliable data our users experience every day. You'll design and build high-performance backend services, push our web scraping and data pipelines to new scale, and help shape the architecture that keeps everything running smoothly as we grow. If you thrive on distributed systems, high-throughput data, and clean, performant code — and you like being the person others turn to in an architectural discussion — we would like to hear from you.

**Responsibilities

**

• Develop scalable, high-performance backend services using Node.js, NestJS, and TypeScript

• Build and optimize advanced web scraping systems capable of handling billions of products daily

• Implement real-time data pipelines and stream processing solutions using Kafka

• Leverage in-memory caching with Redis to ensure extremely fast data retrieval and updates

• Work closely with our distributed NoSQL databases to handle large-scale data effectively

• Collaborate in a cross-functional team — taking an active part in architectural discussions, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions

**What we’re looking for 🌟

****We Imagine That You Have

**

• Strong expertise in Node.js and dependency injection frameworks such as NestJS

• Solid understanding and hands-on experience with PubSub/Kafka or other stream processing tools

• Proficiency in managing and optimizing NoSQL or SQL databases, with practical experience using Redis or other in-memory databases for caching

• Familiarity with cloud-native technologies, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and microservices architecture

• Experience managing distributed systems and microservices at scale

**It is further seen as an advantage to have experience with:

**

• Designing and implementing efficient web scraping systems

• MongoDB in production global / sharded use-cases

• Multi-cluster / multi-regional deployments and databases, or Vector Search use-cases

• AI applications at work — e.g. reviewer agents or similar

• High-performance applications dealing with high I/O scenarios

Why GoWish should sit at top of your career wish list 💙

At GoWish, we believe great work comes from people who feel energized, supported, and excited to show up every day. That’s why we’ve built a workplace where celebration, growth, and genuine enjoyment are part of the journey - not perks on the side.

Take your birthday off with Happy Birthday Leave, enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully recharge, and join a team that fills the year with events and playful happenings. We invest in your future with pension and insurance, fuel your days with a weekly lunch scheme, and keep you going with unlimited snacks and sodas - because work should feel good.

At GoWish, you don’t just build great products. You build a great work life.

**Practical information

**We collaborate in a flexible setup, with most of our magic happening at our bright, modern office in Østerbro - perfectly placed between Nordhavn and Østerport Station. We’re ready for you to join us as soon as you are.

👉 Ready to help shape a platform that already empowers 18+ million users (and counting)? Join us at GoWish - and let’s build the future of data-driven innovation together.

Don’t wait to apply - we review applications continuously and may close the position once the right candidate is found.

All Gravy is the AI-native people operating platform for hospitality and retail. 🥞

We're modernising how frontline teams work, replacing scattered tools and outdated systems with a single app that's actually built for the way people work & socialise today. Our AI Colleague gives staff instant answers & executes day-to-day tasks, freeing up managers to focus on people & customers instead of paperwork. We work with some of the most exciting brands in hospitality and retail, including Gail's, L'Osteria, Dishoom, Pizza Pilgrims, Ottolenghi, Q8 and 7-Eleven. Today over 2,000 restaurants and stores trust us to run their teams.

We've grown 10x in two years and are accelerating into new markets. Our team spans a wide range of nationalities and backgrounds, united by one mission: to create better work lives for the 80% of the world that do not sit behind a desk. 🚀

**🤩 About The Role

**We are looking for Senior Account Executive who loves the chase, the close and the craft. You’ll own a territory and build your own pipeline of high-value targets, and booming inbound channel feeding you qualified opportunities. You call the shots on where to hunt, who to warm, and how to win. We’ll back you with marketing air cover, product firepower, and leadership you can trust for support and development.

**🎯 What You Will Do

**

• Create and run your target list of dream logos in our ICP. Name them, map them, multi-thread them.

• Work a blended pipe: your self-sourced opportunities plus SDR-sourced meetings you turn into revenue.

• Full cycle everything: discovery → tailored demo → value proof → commercial design → close → high-five.

• Build business cases that make budget holders nod and sign (ROI, payback, the whole nine yards).

• Feedback like a pro: turn deal learnings into sharper messaging, better product bets, and smoother process.

• Beat targets without burning out.

🙌 **You’ll thrive here if you…

**

• You speak excellent English and are based in Copenhagen.

• 5+ years of SaaS sales under your belt, fluent in consultative selling, and MEDPICC. Psst... If you’ve sold into hospitality, we’re listening even harder.

• You’re curious, ambitious, disciplined, and self-driven.

• Are owner-minded. You don’t wait for leads, you create momentum and you love a clean CRM.

• Can navigate complex cycles and senior stakeholders, you’re credible in the boardroom and fun.

• Are data-curious and coachable. You test, learn, and iterate faster than most people.

**💎 Why All Gravy

**

• Grow fast, for real. We promote from within, move quickly, and give you real responsibility from day one.

• A culture that actually develops you. Honest feedback, active coaching, and the autonomy to experiment. We invest in you because your growth is our growth.

• Work that matters. Your work will directly impact the daily lives of millions of frontline workers.

• You'll work with people who've built, scaled, and won. Ex-founders, operators, all here because they want to do it again, bigger.

• The good stuff too. Prime office location, team lunches, Friday bars, padel tournaments, wine tastings, offsites, top-tier equipment, and a fridge that's always stocked. We work hard and celebrate harder.

Ready to roll? Curious, competitive, kind? Apply, even if you don’t tick every box. Attitude and growth mindset matter. Let’s build the future of frontline work together.

**About us:

**Founded in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2014, Templafy’s success is built by our 60+ employee nationalities found at offices around the world. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and empowered, they perform at their best—creating a win for all. Our unique product and dedication to innovation and excellence have raised over $200 million in funding from top investors like Insight Venture Partners, Seed Capital, Dawn Capital, Damgaard Company and Golub Capital.

**Role Overview

**The Sales Executive, EMEA is responsible for developing new enterprise relationships and helping customers realise meaningful value from Templafy’s Agentic Solutions.

Based in our Copenhagen office, you will work with large organisations across EMEA to understand how they create business-critical documents and identify opportunities to make those processes faster, more accurate and easier to govern.

You will lead complex enterprise sales processes from initial outreach, engagement through to commercial agreement, working closely with customers and Templafy specialists to build a clear business case and demonstrate how Templafy can support document workflows, brand governance and enterprise AI adoption.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Build and develop a high-quality pipeline of new enterprise opportunities across EMEA.

• Run new-business sales cycles from initial outreach, engagement and discovery through to negotiation and close.

• Understand customers’ business priorities and identify opportunities to accelerate important document workflows, improve consistency and reduce unnecessary manual effort.

• Help customers quantify the value of improving how documents are created, governed and maintained across their organisation.

• Develop compelling business cases that connect Templafy’s capabilities to measurable customer outcomes.

• Engage senior business and technology stakeholders on the opportunities and challenges created by AI, including adoption, governance, scalability and reliable enterprise outcomes.

• Work closely with pre-Sales and other specialists to bring relevant customer use cases to life and demonstrate value using real-world workflows.

• Build strong, trusted relationships across complex stakeholder groups and maintain disciplined pipeline management, qualification and forecasting.

**Experience

**

• 5+ years of enterprise SaaS or software sales experience, with a strong focus on new business.

• A track record of achieving sales targets and winning complex, enterprise opportunities.

• Experience building pipeline as well as developing opportunities generated through Marketing, partners and other channels.

• Experience working with senior business and technology stakeholders within large organisations.

• Strong experience in consultative, value-based enterprise selling.

• Experience selling across EMEA is advantageous.

**Employee Benefits:

**

• Employee equity program

• Private health insurance

• Company lunch contribution

• Phone and broadband covered by company

• Centrally located office – easy access to public transportation

• Company events and team activities

• Flexible work environment

• Gympass Subscription

• Calm App Subscription

At Templafy, we’re all about building an inclusive culture where talented people come together to spark creativity in a dynamic, collaborative space. Strong relationships and teamwork are at the core of everything we do, and with our flat structure, everyone’s ideas count regardless of your role or experience.

We’re big on social events that foster connection and build a diverse, empowering community. From celebrating milestones to participating in employee resource groups or eating lunch together, we create space for meaningful team bonding.

Our mission goes beyond just building a product; we’re shaping the future, and we’d love for you to be a part of this epic journey with us.

_Templafy is a workplace of belongingness. To us this means that you have a voice, you dare to speak up, and your voice is heard. We focus on offering an environment that allows all employees to feel that they belong regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, genetic information, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or other status.

_Templafy is the leading AI-powered document generation platform for companies with a need to create accurate, compliant, and on-brand documents with maximum efficiency and ease. Accessible directly from applications like Microsoft Office, Google Workspace and Salesforce, Templafy is trusted by more than 800 industry leading enterprises, including KPMG, Adobe, and PWC. Our platform simplifies document workflows and eliminates the complexity and risk associated with the content creation process.

About ChemoMetec

ChemoMetec is a worldwide leading manufacturer of cell counting and analysis equipment. We specialize in developing and producing high-precision instrumentation, delivering consistent data for thousands of customers across biotech, pharma, and academic segments.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized and scientifically skilled Product Specialist - Technical Support & Documentation to lead technical support for ChemoMetec’s portfolio of analytical cell-counting instruments. In this support-centered role, you will handle technical inquiries from both customers and colleagues and act as the go-to reference for technically accurate and compliant solutions. The role combines life science, technical documentation, and QA collaboration, making it ideal for someone with a strong scientific background and a passion for structured problem-solving.

We are hiring two Product Specialists for our technical support team: one focused on documentation and one on data analysis. You will be part of the Product Management Department and work closely with QA, Field Application Scientists, and product teams to resolve customer complaints, complete technical documentation, and maintain our support infrastructure. A solid foundation in mathematics and validation methodologies, along with a strong understanding of GMP regulatory requirements, is essential to succeed in this role.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide technical support across all instrument platforms, with a focus on structured problem-solving and documentation.

• Collaborate with QA to complete technical questionnaires and support the resolution of customer complaints.

• Maintain and organize our support database platform, ensuring technical records are accurate and accessible.

• Proofread and write technical notes, user guides, and comparison studies.

• Develop and implement procedures to support both existing and new products.

• Ensure all support activities comply with GMP and relevant quality standards.

• Act as a subject matter expert on instrumentation and scientific applications, providing technical insight to internal teams.

Your Profile

• PhD in Biology, Physics, or a related scientific discipline.

• Solid foundation in mathematics and validation methodologies, and a strong understanding of GMP regulatory requirements.

• Strong understanding of microscopy, analytical instrumentation, and pharmaceutical workflows.

• Highly organized, structured, and detail-oriented.

• Excellent written communication skills, with experience producing technical documentation.

• Familiarity with support platforms or ticketing systems is a plus.

• Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, technical environment.

Why join ChemoMetec?

At ChemoMetec, we believe that great people make a great workplace. We value both personal and professional development and offer an environment where you can grow, take responsibility, and make an impact. You will become part of a team of talented and supportive colleagues who enjoy working together in an informal and welcoming atmosphere. We also believe that strong relationships go beyond the workplace, which is why we regularly bring colleagues together through company-wide events to build connections and strengthen relationships across the organization.

Practical information

Both positions are on-site at our HQ in Allerød, Denmark. You will refer to Director, Ph.D. Product Management Bassam Tawfik.

Starting date is as soon as possible, and we conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. Deadline for applying is 20 November 2026.

If you have any further questions about this job opportunity, feel free to contact Frederikke Hvidberg, fhv@chemometec.com

Please attach a motivation letter and a resume.

On behalf of KINRADEN, MINDWEISS is seeking a commercially minded and hands-on CFO to play a key role in the company's next phase of international growth. With responsibility for strengthening financial management and developing a scalable finance function, you will have significant influence on strategic decisions and the financial foundation supporting KINRADEN's ambitious retail expansion.

As CFO, you will report directly to the CEO and work closely with the wider management team, acting as a trusted financial and strategic sparring partner. You will take full ownership of the finance function, balancing strategic priorities with operational responsibilities while ensuring that financial insights actively support commercial decisions and future investments.

A central part of your responsibility will be to drive financial planning, budgeting, forecasting and performance management, ensuring reliable financial oversight and clear insights into business performance across the organisation and its growing retail operations. You will support strategic and commercial decision-making through financial analysis, business cases and scenario planning, including evaluating the financial implications of new stores, markets and investments.

Furthermore, you will be responsible for cash flow and liquidity management, financial controls and the preparation of relevant management and Board reporting, ensuring transparency and a clear overview of the company's financial position.

You will also oversee the ongoing financial operations, including monthly closing, annual accounts, audits, tax, VAT and financial compliance. As KINRADEN continues to expand internationally, you will play a key role in developing scalable financial processes, systems and governance to support increasing business complexity and long-term growth.

Strong financial expertise and commercial understanding

To succeed in this role, you bring solid experience from a senior finance position and strong expertise in financial accounting, controlling, budgeting, forecasting and cash flow management. Your ability to combine financial expertise with commercial understanding enables you to support strategic decisions and evaluate business opportunities.

We expect you to have a relevant academic degree in finance, accounting or economics, ideally complemented by experience from an international business with multiple legal entities. A background in retail, consumer goods or luxury would be an advantage, although specific industry experience is not essential. Furthermore, you are fluent in English, have excellent Microsoft Office skills and are able to communicate financial insights clearly and effectively.

A grounded and collaborative finance leader

On a personal level, you are grounded, confident and approachable, with the professional maturity to build trust through your expertise and sound judgement. You take ownership naturally and work independently, while maintaining a collaborative and down-to-earth approach. To thrive in this role, it is essential that you are comfortable navigating changing priorities and can move seamlessly between strategic discussions and hands-on execution. Furthermore, your flexibility and pragmatic mindset enable you to contribute positively to KINRADEN's informal and creative culture.

About KINRADEN

Founded in 2014 by Sarah Emilie Müllertz, KINRADEN is a modern luxury brand shaped by influences ranging from Japanese design traditions to Danish architecture. With a deep commitment to sustainability, the brand actively supports two of the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals: ensuring fair and dignified employment practices (Goal 8), and advocating for responsible production and consumption (Goal 12).

KINRADEN operates with a flat organizational structure and a work culture built on trust, responsibility, and a welcoming, down-to-earth atmosphere. The company embraces a distinctly Danish way of working—informal, friendly, and rooted in strong relationships. Collaboration is key, fostering a close-knit community where people support one another and value inclusivity.

Apply for the Position

Does this sound like the right opportunity for you? We would very much like to hear from you. Please apply by clicking the “Apply” button in this job posting and uploading your CV. Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis, and the position will be closed once the right candidate has been found.

We place emphasis on your competencies, qualifications, and ambitions, as well as a strong mutual fit between you and the company’s culture and values. Therefore, we encourage you not to include age, photo, nationality, or marital status in your CV. The right match is always about more than an impressive CV.

jobs.occupation: Two-year postdoc in developing inventory of agricultural nitrous oxide emissions
jobs.description:
The Department of Environmental Science and the Department of Agroecology at Aarhus University, Denmark, welcomes applications for a postdoctoral researcher position in developing a Tier 3 model-based national inventory of N₂O emissions modelling from cultivation of soils. The position is part of the SmartField project, which is a cross-organizational research project aimed at obtaining knowledge about N₂O emissions from agricultural fields and solutions for mitigation strategies. Additionally, SmartField will develop and deliver an improved methodology for accounting N₂O emissions at farm and national scale.

Expected start date and duration of employment

The position is to be filled by February 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter and is a two-year fixed-term position.

Job description

You will be part of a research environment addressing greenhouse gas emissions and sustainability transition of agricultural systems, with a particular focus on nitrous oxide emissions from agricultural soil aiming to scale emission estimates from the field to the national scale. Your role will primarily involve supporting the development and implementation of a model-based approach for the national of N₂O emissions from diverse agricultural soils, as well as developing the data pipeline. This will include creating and updating spatio-temporal datasets on soils, cropping systems, and field management, and calculating and assessing and comparing the resulting inventories to other approaches. Scenarios will be used to explore how mitigation technologies and management measures could reduce N₂O emissions and to assess the suitability of the proposed Tier 3 modelling framework for Denmark's national N₂O emission inventory. Your work will support a Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV) system, enabling transparent, robust and science-based reporting of mitigation progress regarding agricultural field N₂O emission. You will work in close collaboration with colleagues developing and testing process-oriented models, as well as with those responsible for the national greenhouse gas inventory.

Your profile

We are searching for a highly motivated candidate who has:

• A PhD in agronomy, soil science, data science, environmental sciences, engineering, agroecology, biology, or a related field.

• Experience working with models, managing and analyzing large datasets.

• Experience working with models related to nitrogen/carbon turnover in soil is considered an advantage but is not required.

• Documented experience in scientific writing and publishing in peer-reviewed scientific journals.

• The ability to communicate effectively in English (both written and oral).

• Good collaboration skills and ability to take responsibility to work independently and proactively on the project

Who we are

The position is shared between the Department of Environmental Science and the Department of Agroecology under the Faculty of Technical Sciences at Aarhus University, and it will be hosted by the Land-CRAFT Center at the AU campus in Aarhus.

The Department of Environmental Science is an interdisciplinary department with expertise ranging from physics, chemistry, microbiology, engineering, social science, geography, economics, to policy analysis. Basic as well as applied research are conducted on some of the major challenges facing society, such as pollution and pollution control mechanisms, management of land, soil, water, air and biodiversity, protection of ecosystem services, and climate change. Advisory services within these areas are offered to governmental organizations, non-governmental organizations and companies. The department consists of five sections and currently about 160 staff (including postdocs and Ph.D. students).

The Department of Agroecology contributes to sustainable solutions to some of the world’s biggest problems within the areas of soil, plants, animals, humans, and the environment. We want to make a difference by contributing to both fundamental knowledge generation and the attainment of sustainable production systems via innovative research, contracted policy advice, and education. We offer professional laboratories, greenhouses, semi-field, and field-scale research facilities, advanced computing capacities as well as an extensive national and international researcher network.  The department consists of nine research sections with around 400 highly skilled employees.

This position is hosted by Land-CRAFT - the Center for Landscape Research in Sustainable Agricultural Future, which aims to bring transformational solutions to agricultural systems. Land-CRAFT is a section within the Department of Agroecology. Therefore, there is a strong focus on climate change mitigation and adaptation strategies.

Both departments believe in equality, diversity, inclusion, and creating an attractive work/life balance.

What we offer

• A collaborative, international research environment that combines high academic standards with an informal and supportive atmosphere. We value accountability, curiosity, flexibility, and teamwork in everything we do.

• An inclusive and respectful workplace culture, where mutual trust, kindness, and professional dialogue are part of daily life. We encourage open communication and develop a cohesive sense of community across teams and disciplines.

• A flexible working environment that supports work-life balance and individual needs.

• An active institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion – in recruitment, career development, and everyday interactions.

• An innovative and meaningful workplace where your work contributes to solving real-world challenges. No two days are alike, and we welcome creative thinking and new ideas.

• Support for international researchers and their families, including Relocation Service and an Expat Partner Programme.

Place of work and area of employment

The place of work is Aarhus University (LandCRAFT Center), Ole Worms Allé 3, 8000 Aarhus C. The affiliation will be with the Department of Environmental Science. However, it should also be expected that there will be work-related and meeting activities at the Department of Environmental Science which is located at Risø in Roskilde.

Contact information

Further information may be obtained by contacting Head of Section Emissions and Atmospheric Modelling, Professor Peter L. Langen (plangen@envs.au.dk +4520618369), Professor Jørgen E. Olesen (jeo@agro.au.dk +4540821659), or Special consultant related to the national emission inventory Mette Hjorth Mikkelsen (mhm@envs.au.dk +4587158579).

Deadline

All applications must be received no later than November 27, 2026.

Application procedure

Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.

Formalities and salary range

Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

**OrderYOYO | Copenhagen based

****What We Do At OrderYOYO

**We help restaurants succeed online by providing them with personalised branded mobile apps, websites and personalised marketing. We are ensuring that small to medium-sized restaurants and chains are not subjected to lofty commissions and giving the restaurant the ownership of their success.

**About The Role

**Commercial Data Analyst

Location: Copenhagen base

Hours: 40hours/ week

Salary: up to 40,000DKK/ month

We are looking for an analytical and commercially minded Commercial Data Analyst to join us, reporting to our CCO. You’ll turn data from across our commercial teams, covering sales, account management, customer success, B2B marketing, pricing and partner performance, into clear, actionable insight, giving our leaders one trusted view of performance across every OrderYOYO market. Working closely with market leads, Sales, Marketing, Finance and Product, you’ll help us understand what drives growth in each market and focus our efforts where they’ll make the biggest difference!

**Here’s a taste of what you’ll be doing:

**

• Analysing performance across all our commercial activities, including sales, account management, customer success, marketing and partnerships, in every market.

• Tracking and reporting on key commercial metrics such as new restaurant acquisition, revenue, order volumes, churn, retention and pipeline conversion.

• Owning our regular commercial reporting, including weekly, monthly and quarterly performance packs for leadership.

• Designing, building and maintaining dashboards that give a single, trusted view of performance and let teams self-serve their data.

• Comparing performance between our 11 markets, teams and channels to spot what’s working, where we can improve and where the risks are.

• Analysing the impact of pricing, campaigns and commercial initiatives on performance.

• Delivering ad hoc analysis to answer business questions and support commercial decisions, business cases and initiatives.

• Making sure commercial data is accurate and consistent across markets, working with CRM and system owners to close any gaps.

• Defining and documenting KPIs so everyone measures performance in the same way.

• Supporting forecasting, target setting and planning with Finance, and flagging variances against target early.

• Your success will be measured on the accuracy and timeliness of reporting, dashboard adoption, data quality, turnaround on ad hoc requests, forecast accuracy and stakeholder satisfaction.

**What We Are Looking For In You

**

• Proven experience in a commercial, sales, revenue or business analyst role.

• Experience building dashboards and reports in BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau or Looker.

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, and experience working with CRM data (e.g. HubSpot or Salesforce).

• A strong understanding of commercial metrics such as revenue, pipeline, conversion, churn and retention, ideally within B2B SaaS.

• Analytical and curious: you can turn data into clear, actionable insight and recommendations.

• A confident communicator who can present findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels.

• Highly organised, with great attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.

• Comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

• Experience working across multiple markets, or with Python or R, is an advantage.

**Great to Have

**

• Experience working across multiple markets or countries.

• Experience with Python or R.

• Experience working in a high-growth, fast-paced business.

• Experience supporting forecasting, target setting or commercial planning alongside Finance.

• Experience defining KPIs or improving data governance and processes.

**About The Company Culture

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.

Monjasa is a global partner in the oil and shipping industries. Its core business includes oil trading and supply, terminal operations, agency, and ship-owning activities. Founded in Denmark in 2002, Monjasa today employs approximately 750 people, serves customers in more than 800 ports and operates a fleet of 30 vessels. The group also provides offshore hotels and project services through CBED Floating Hotels.

Global financial controlling and reporting

As Group Controller, you will join the group controlling team and work with the preparation and consolidation of monthly internal financial statements, budgets, and year-end external financial statements. You will validate financial figures across group companies and work closely with finance teams in Denmark and Finance Managers worldwide.

Specific work tasks:

• Controlling and reviewing of a broad variety of Danish entities within various industries.

• Participating in preparation of internal reporting to Management and the Board of Directors.

• Participating in the preparation of the group annual report and the year-end process for a broad variety of Danish entities.

• Further develop and maintain group-related controlling and review processes, ensuring lean and effective procedures.

• Building and maintaining strong relations with internal stakeholders.

• Participating in budget and estimate processes.

• Act as sparring partner for the group accounting team.

• Analysing group financial performance and development.

• Preparing audit material.

• Assisting with the quality assurance of consolidated figures.

• Assisting group Tax with corporate income tax returns.

Based in Fredericia, you will report to the Group Finance Director and join a group finance team of 10 employees. The role includes 5-10 travel days a year and offers flexibility regarding working from home.

Ambitious and curious financial profile with strong interpersonal skills

We expect you to hold a cand.merc.aud or HD-R and have at least three years of experience as an auditor working with international clients. Experience from a similar role in an international organisation is an advantage. You know Danish accounting requirements and IFRS, have strong skills in Excel, ERP, consolidation and BI tools, and you communicate fluently in Danish and English.

We are looking for a Group Controller who is independent and proactive. You are committed to meeting deadlines and delivering high-quality work on time. Curious and unafraid to challenge the status quo, you are ambitious and committed to achieving high-quality results. You possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills and communicate effectively with individuals at all levels and across cultures.

Join Monjasa – a global company with a strong team spirit

**AI is moving from prototypes to production-ready solutions. The engineers who can take it there matter more than ever.

At Heyra, we build operational AI: systems, workflows, and data platforms that live in production from day one. We work with companies that are moving quickly and need solutions that improve the way they operate.

We're looking for an AI Engineer who is as comfortable in the code as in the data underneath it. Someone who can design, build, and ship AI solutions today, and grow into setting technical direction as the company grows.

On smaller engagements, you may be the only engineer on the project, which means owning it from problem to production yourself. On larger ones, you'll work closely with engineers, data specialists, strategists, and designers in a company where ideas move quickly, and the distance from thinking to building is intentionally small.

What you'll work on

• Designing and deploying AI solutions across domains like finance, operations, and supply chain

• Building predictive models, automated workflows, and agentic systems

• Owning the data work behind your own models and agents

• Building eval systems that measure whether an agent actually works

• Leading client projects from problem to production

• Translating business needs into AI solutions that actually ship

• Integrating scalable AI systems through APIs and cloud environments

**Requirements

****You probably have experience with

**

• Software development, ML or data engineering, with AI applications running in production

• Fluent Python and at least one agent framework or SDK

• Training ML models and handling the data preparation behind them

• Building or extending eval systems for agent behaviour

• Building scalable systems in cloud environments like Azure or GCP

• Coding with agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor

• Stakeholder management and leading delivery end-to-end

Curiosity, taste and builder mentality matter just as much to us as specific tools or years of experience.

Why Heyra

We believe consulting needs to be rewritten. We are building a consultancy designed for the agentic era. We design, build and operate AI products that change how enterprises work, from problem to prototype to production.

Heyra brings together people from engineering, strategy, product, startup and creative environments. We keep teams small, collaboration close and momentum high. We care deeply about craft, speed and building things that work in the real world.

People here care about what they build. Good ideas move quickly. New technology gets explored early. There is room to shape both the company and the way we work.

We are around 45 people today, and we are only just getting started.

If this sounds like your kind of work, send us a short note about yourself together with your CV. We care much more about curiosity, energy and the way you think than polished applications.

**Benefits

**

• Healthcare insurance

• Pension plan

• Parental leave

• Social gatherings

• New tech gear

• Central office

• Free lunch, coffee, snacks, and Friday beers

• Skill development

• Paid holiday

• Remote work allowed

• Pet friendly

The opportunity

Founded in 2016, Mover is a Danish logistics technology company on a mission to change logistics for good, reducing waste and making people’s lives better.

Are you passionate about building great software products? Do you obsess over your customers? Are you interested in working with the latest state-of-the-art AI-driven development practices in order to invent and simplify? Would you like to have an outsized impact in a small Copenhagen B2B SaaS company, and make your mark on the Nordics last-mile logistics market? If so, Mover might be the right place for you.

We are currently brewing up new product ideas, and in need of strong product managers. We are looking for someone willing to take ownership of specific commercial goals and realize them with a great product. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage a backlog. We need a product leader who enjoys spending time with customers, challenging assumptions, making difficult prioritization decisions, and working closely with engineering and leadership to shape the future of our last-mile platform.

If that’s something for you, then please read on!

Role overview and responsibilities

As a Product Manager you will:

• Turn strategy into reality: Launch a new B2B SaaS product in the first 12 months.

• Take ownership and deliver results on revenue, gross profit and related commercial goals for your product.

• Lead a small product team in a matrix-style org structure (not a people manager, but a team leader).

• Use AI to its full potential - in the product development process, and in the product itself.

• Perform market research and help drive our continuous discovery process.

• Talk to customers. A lot. Both existing and prospects.

• Build long-term relationships with senior stakeholders and customers.

• Take a primarily data-driven approach to product development and product operations.

• Have a real, measurable impact on the daily lives of thousands of drivers across Europe.

Your mindset

• You are driven by purpose and want to contribute to our mission of changing logistics for good.

• You are driven, tenacious, and can work independently. You think big and insist on the highest standards. You have a bias for action and accomplish more with less. You listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have strong opinions and no issue voicing them. However, once a decision has been made, you commit wholly to the path forward.

• You can sell a vision to customers.

• What success looks like (12 months)

• You have successfully launched a new product.

About you

• We imagine you have 5+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, but we are also interested in equivalent qualifications from marketing, sales or other commercial functions, with relevant project management experience and customer obsession.

• Preferably experience in launching (not just operating) a new B2B SaaS product.

• The ability and curiosity to quickly learn a complex domain (last-mile logistics).

• The ability to navigate ambiguity and create clarity.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English.

• Experience working with cross-functional product teams.

• Understanding of software life-cycle processes: How software is built, maintained and scaled.

What we offer

• A high degree of responsibility from day one, working alongside experienced colleagues.

• A steep learning curve in a fast-moving technology company.

• Autonomy, trust, and support to do the best work of your career.

• An open, collaborative environment with talented peers across multiple functions.

• Aaaand, a great lunch, modern offices and a cool location at Islands Brygge in the center of Copenhagen…

Mover’s values

We move fast. We expect people to own problems end-to-end, not wait to be told what to do. You know best, so you need to bring a lot of creativity. We obsess over the people who use our software, from logistics planners to drivers, and we would rather ship a small improvement this week than a perfect one next year. We are direct and honest with each other, including about our own mistakes, and we hold a high bar for quality.

• 
Lead with integrity. We believe that integrity is a reciprocal value. It means treating others as we wish to be treated. With respect, honesty, and sound ethics

• 
Be accountable. We embrace freedom in decision-making, initiative, and actions while accepting full responsibility for outcomes and results

• 
Push boundaries. We challenge norms, innovate, and move fast to drive changes to continuously improve things for everyone affected by our products and services

• 
Play, as a team. We are serious without taking ourselves too seriously, and balance having fun with achieving great things, together

Interested? We would love to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: Engineering Graduation Project in HV/MV Protection Department, Renewables Division, Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Are you approaching the end of your studies and looking for a graduation project early 2027. Does deep dive into the protection of the primary equipment enabling transport of wind energy to shore excite you? Then we have the project for you.

The projects

Protection study

Today we apply state of the art, cutting edge protections of the primary equipment, 220/66kV transformers, shunt reactors, subsea cables etc. Functions like line differential protection, restricted earth fault protection, distance protection with fiber optic accelerations schemes and different mechanical protections.

But how well do the different protections cover the primary equipment?

Are all protections feasible, considering how often we statistically experience faults?

Grounding

Today the MV grid, connecting the wind turbines to the Offshore Sub Station is impedance grounded. This creates different problems and side effects that needs to be considered during engineering. Some primary equipment becomes expensive and hard to procure. Protection against earth faults becomes challenging because of the reduced fault current.

Investigate the benefits and disadvantages of isolated, impedance and effectively grounded MV grid.

How will the protections need to be set up?

What will the implications be on primary equipment, transformers, cables, wind turbines etc.

Your Profile & Qualifications

We image that you are studying to become an Electrical Engineer. As a person you are ambitious and result oriented. You have an analytical mindset and strive to find solutions for complex problems and at the same time you enjoy collaborating within a team. Furthermore, you have a strong interest in learning and taking on challenges.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you have the following qualifications:

• Interest in electrical systems.

• Focus on digitalization and innovation.

• Can communicate in English, both written and verbal.

• Flexible, committed, loyal and dedicated.

• Great communication skills.

Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, you must submit your application as soon as possible.

If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Søren Borre Kreipke, Manager, HV Protection & Secondary at SOBK@semcomaritime.com
